rubrics.rubric: Does the dispatch review table include exactly one row for each of the 18 incidents in the extract?
criterion: The table contains 18 incident rows, excluding any header row.
Each row corresponds to one unique starfire incident ID with no duplicate incident IDs.

rubrics.rubric: Does every table row include the full required field set?
criterion: Each row includes incident ID, incident time, reported location, ZIP code, and incident classification.
Each row includes a priority tier and a current assignment assessment.
Each row includes a closest practical Brooklyn firehouse and a brief note.
